etymology.historical_story: No historical origin can be assigned to this lowercase token without context. One documented uppercase use is BFG, meaning Big Friendly Giant in Roald Dahl's children's fiction. The novel appeared in 1982, but that literary history does not identify this packet's token. Its provenance and intended expansion therefore remain unresolved. [Roald Dahl Museum](https://www.roalddahlmuseum.org/archive/roald-dahls-published-works/)
